Absender passt nicht zum Netz: Sender does not match the network
Als Dienst markieren (z. B. Discord-Noti: Mark as service (e.g. Discord notifier), it then no longer counts
Am Paket nicht zu unterscheiden:: Cannot be told apart from the packet:
Bekannter Lärm (Steam, mDNS, SSDP …) ist: Known noise (Steam, mDNS, SSDP …) is shown.
Bisher kam für kein eingeschaltetes Spie: Nothing has arrived for any switched-on game so far.
Bisher kein Broadcast auf einem unbekann: No broadcast on an unknown port so far.
Bisher keine Broadcasts auf Ports ohne R: No broadcasts on ports without a rule so far.
Broadcasts without a rule, from all networks. If a game is listed next to one, it is just switched off.
Broadcasts ohne passendes Spiel. Fehlt e: Broadcasts without a matching game. If a game is missing, it shows up here first.
Then only what this PC sends counts.
Das Spiel ist an, aber es entsteht keine: The game is on, but no rule is created. It has no broadcast ports on record.
Den Mitschnitt für die Spiele-Datenbank: Keep the capture for the game database.
Die Engine antwortet nicht. Der Port-Fin: The engine does not answer. The port finder runs in the engine.
Die Engine antwortet nicht. Die Liste ko: The engine does not answer. The list comes back as soon as it runs.
Die Engine hat noch keinen Stand bekomme: The engine has not received a revision yet. Switch on a game or pick a mode under System.
Die Engine läuft mit einem anderen Stand: The engine runs with a different revision than the latest one.
Die Kennung darf nur Kleinbuchstaben, Zi: The ID may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _.
Die Weboberfläche erreicht die Engine ni: The web interface cannot reach the engine. Whether anything is being relayed right now is unknown. Check the container nsrelay-engine-1.
Diese Kennung gibt es schon. Bitte eine: This ID already exists. Please pick another one.
This game does not search by broadcast. The relay cannot help here. Read the notes below.
Ein Spiel fehlt in der Liste? Der Port-F: A game is missing from the list? The port finder shows what it calls into the LAN. One click turns that into a game.
Ein anderes Gerät leitet dieselben Broad: Another device relays the same broadcasts. If it keeps running, this relay must not be active.
Ein anderes Relay war zuerst da und send: Another relay was there first and is sending. This one takes over once the other has been silent for 10 seconds.
Is created as soon as the game is on.
Erst prüfbar, wenn Suchanfragen ankommen: Can only be checked once search requests arrive.
Erwartet, solange ein anderes Relay para: Expected as long as another relay runs in parallel.
Es prüft kurz, ob schon ein anderes Rela: It briefly checks whether another relay is already sending, then gets going.
Es wird nichts weitergeleitet. Spiele au: Nothing is relayed. Games from other networks are not found.
Es zählt mit und sendet nichts. Über die: It counts and sends nothing. Nobody finds a game through this relay.
Gerade sucht oder hostet niemand. Sobald: Nobody is searching or hosting right now. As soon as someone opens the LAN browser, it shows up here.
Switched on in the active event.
Keine, weil das Relay gerade nicht weite: None, because the relay is not relaying right now.
Netz des Test-PCs wählen, am besten auch: Pick the network of the test PC, ideally its address too.
Noch keine Sitzung. Netz wählen, starten: No session yet. Pick a network, start, then start the game on the test PC and open the LAN browser.
Noch nichts angekommen. Ist das Spiel im: Nothing has arrived yet. Is the game in the LAN browser?
Pakete kommen an, werden aber nicht kopi: Packets arrive but are not copied. Check under Network whether the target networks are on, and under System the dropped packets.
Pakete kreisen. Die betroffene Regel ist: Packets are going in circles. The affected rule is slowed down. Look for a second relay or a bridge between the networks.
Pakete pro Sekunde, die aus dem Netz bei: Packets per second that reach the relay from the network. A table without players in the LAN browser stays quiet. If a tile shows an alarm, it leads to the alarm.
Port-Finder gestoppt. Die Ergebnisse ble: Port finder stopped. The results stay until the next start.
Port-Finder läuft. Jetzt das Spiel start: Port finder is running. Now start the game and open the LAN browser.
Switch it on above. That takes effect right away.
Schau in den <a href=\"/verlauf\">Verlau: Have a look at the history.
Seit dem Start der Engine kam auf diesen: Nothing has arrived on these ports since the engine started. Is someone opening the LAN browser in the game? Otherwise: switch off a second network card or VPN on the PC, check the firewall.
Seit dem Start der Engine. „+2“ heißt: z: Since the engine started. “+2” means: two more games use the same port. Who is playing right now is listed under Players.
Spiele-Broadcasts werden zwischen den Ne: Game broadcasts are copied between the networks.
Starten. Am PC das Spiel öffnen, den LAN: Start. Open the game on the PC, go to the LAN browser and host a game once.
Sturm-Bremse hat eine Regel pausiert: Storm brake has paused a rule
Suchanfragen kommen an und werden kopier: Search requests arrive and are copied. If still nobody finds the game, it is the game traffic afterwards (see below) or the PC.
Taucht ein gesehener Alarm nach mindeste: If an acknowledged alarm comes back after at least a minute of quiet, it is open again. After five minutes without a new event it disappears.
UDP %s is copied between the networks.
Verwalten unter <a href=\"/system#dienst: Manage under System → Services in the network.
Vom Relay abgefragt: Der Server meldet s: Probed by the relay: the server does not announce itself, it only answers search requests
Was dahintersteckt, zeigt der <a href=\": The port finder shows what is behind them.
Was danach dazukommt, ist als <span clas: Whatever shows up after that is marked new. For an unknown port: Add game.
Welche Ports das Spiel für die LAN-Suche: Which ports the game uses for the LAN search is not certain. Look at “Unknown ports” on the overview while someone opens the LAN browser.
Wer in den letzten 15 Minuten ein Spiel: Who searched for or offered a game in the last 15 minutes, sorted by game.
Switch back on: operator or admin.
Zu viele Pakete auf einem Port. Die Rege: Too many packets on one port. The rule pauses only for the network they come from and starts again by itself.
Ein Relay ohne denselben Schlüssel oder: A relay without the same key, or a forged beacon. This relay ignores it and stays active. If the other relay belongs here, give both the same NSRELAY_BEACON_KEY.
Zwei Relays für dieselben Netze. Eins vo: Two relays for the same networks. One of them has to go off.
Zweites Relay aktiv, dieses hält still: Second relay active, this one stays quiet
offener Server, selbst gemeldet oder vom: open server, announced by itself or probed by the relay (e.g. CS2)
sucht oder hostet, am Paket nicht zu unt: searching or hosting, cannot be told apart from the packet (e.g. FlatOut)
